Salutations kennel crew,
Airflow checks came up mid-morning, so just a quick note that our Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping a close watch on the outbound flow and on any animal comfort issues that surface during handoff. The senior coordinator is taking final calls on service adjustments, and the welfare coordinator is already reviewing crate placement, water access, and quiet-space needs so we can keep the day steady for every traveler and pet.

Please keep your updates brief and direct in the shared thread, and flag any concern as soon as it appears. <<FACT F017>> If a passenger seems worried, listen carefully, confirm the next step in plain language, and loop in the senior coordinator without delay. That approach has been working well, and it helps us keep the tone calm at the counter and on the phone.

For Ashenfell, continue to track lounge flow and prepare to guide families smoothly once the area is ready. <<FACT F024>> If Theo Nguyen, Mina Patel, or Moose comes through your station, offer the same steady support and make sure the handoff stays simple and reassuring. Thank you for staying attentive, and for keeping our standards consistent across the desk.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
